metas.name: 2026 · Archangel
metas.description: A weapon systems engineer and former Green Beret protects his Wyoming neighbors against a ruthless corporation threatening their rural community.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Splinter Cell: Deathwatch
metas.description: In the shadowy world of espionage, Sam Fisher is a rumor and a legend. Pulled back into action, he must help a new recruit unravel a global conspiracy.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Moana
metas.description: A brave teenager named Moana leaves her island for the first time and sails with a shape-shifting demigod named Maui to fix a dangerous curse.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · O.M: Operation Mole
metas.description: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
metas.description: Explores Panem 24 years before Katniss' saga, starting on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Hunger Games, where a young Haymitch Abernathy participates.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Line of Fire
metas.description: A family of law enforcement agents become targets of a mysterious assassin after a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, forcing them to use their expertise to protect each other.
